description: Recorded achieved sale prices for one address id (HM Land Registry Price Paid, GBP, with the EPC floor area where matched; no per-sale GBP/m2). These are historic transactions, never valuations or asking prices. listingLinks open the postcode on Rightmove (past listings and their photos), Zoopla and OnTheMarket: links only, Close Knit does not fetch or host listings. Coming soon: until Close Knit opens to assistants this tool answers status coming-soon, no data.
name: get_address_history
title: Get address history
